summary: Builds triangle meshes by lofting between point groups or faces, optionally using rest geometry to stabilize point order.
common_gotchas: Polyloft does not add new points, so sparse or irregular inputs can create visibly uneven triangulation.
Rest input only helps when the rest groups match the animated source groups.
Closure and proximity choices can change point correspondence and cause flips if animated casually.
key_concepts: Polyloft SOP generates triangle meshes by stitching points without adding new points.
Input faces or point groups do not need equal point counts, but point ordering still affects the surface.
A rest input can stabilize point order and reduce popping for changing source geometry.
Rest geometry must have groups matching the animated geometry for stable correspondence.
